title: Pastiera 0.85
highlights: QuickLauncher is new: open apps from the keyboard, including from text fields, with fast keyboard-first search.
Messenger and app Enter behavior can now be configured per app, including an optional SYM + Enter send shortcut.
Variations, SYM pages, and the status bar are more flexible, with long-press modes, static variation presets, custom SYM characters, and configurable status bar buttons.
Shortcuts and Nav Mode gained more physical-key options, word navigation, media controls, layout-aware Ctrl shortcuts, and native Ctrl passthrough.

Pastiera 0.85 adds or expands Serbian Cyrillic, Ukrainian, Russian JCUKEN and ЙЦУКЕН, German QWERTZ multi-tap, Greek accents, Vietnamese TELEX, Turkish multi-tap, Danish, Dutch, and Norwegian support.
improvements: Device support was expanded for Q25, BlackBerry Key2, Minimal Phone MP01, Titan 2 Elite QWERTY, and Titan 2 SYM/trackpad behavior.
CLDR-backed emoji search is available in both emoji pickers, with hardware-key input routing and bundled search data for supported locales.
Typing sounds, accessibility labels, TalkBack behavior, backup/restore flows, settings screens, debug tools, tutorial pages, icons, and release-note loading all received smaller improvements.
bugFixes: Fixed keyboard bottom clipping on affected devices.
Prevented Android 14 subtype API crashes on older Android versions.
Speech recognition now uses the current IME subtype language.
F-Droid-installed builds no longer perform GitHub update checks.
Fixed symbol-only substitution triggers, Ctrl passthrough, substitution spacing, modifier latch/hold behavior, and Shift latch tap-off behavior.
Fixed apostrophe and Italian elision autocorrect ranking, including longer forms such as dell' and nell'.
Fixed Q25 Alt mappings for 0 and currency symbols.
Fixed subtype and layout resolution so active and custom layouts are respected instead of falling back to QWERTY in the wrong places.
Backspace delete alternatives no longer intercept normal deletion while text is selected.
Avoided an IME show loop during keyboard visibility evaluation.
Fixed Pastierina suggestion visibility edge cases.
Improved emoji search routing, including the main Ctrl+A/search-focus case.
nightlyRegressionFixes: Fixed Nightly-specific IME selection, application-id, and identity detection issues.
Cleaned up Nightly F-Droid metadata, channel behavior, version codes, and app/IME labels.
Limited signing validation to packaging tasks so non-packaging CI tasks do not fail on missing signing configuration.
Hardened local release and Nightly build tooling, signing attestations, APK verification, and release workflows.
Ctrl-hold Nav Mode stabilization is treated as Nightly stabilization rather than as a headline Stable-user fix.
githubReleaseBody:
Pastiera 0.85 is a large Stable update since v0.84beta. It adds QuickLauncher for keyboard-driven app launching, per-app Enter behavior for messenger workflows, more flexible variation/SYM/status bar controls, more shortcut and Nav Mode options, new layouts and languages, and additional device profiles for Q25, BlackBerry Key2, Minimal Phone MP01, and Titan 2 Elite QWERTY.

Highlights:
- QuickLauncher opens apps from the keyboard, can work from text fields, starts quickly, and supports optional layout-aware search plus conservative typo-tolerant ranking.
- Messenger/app Enter behavior can be configured per app, including optional SYM + Enter send behavior.
- Variation, SYM, and status bar controls now include long-press modes, static variation presets, Dev's Choice, sort-ready SYM pages, custom SYM characters, and configurable undo/redo buttons.
- Shortcuts now support Space, Enter, and Backspace, with Alt+Shift layout switching, forward-delete alternatives, word navigation, media controls, layout-aware Ctrl shortcuts, and native Ctrl passthrough.
- Layout and language support has expanded with Serbian Cyrillic, Ukrainian, Russian JCUKEN and ЙЦУКЕН, German QWERTZ multi-tap, Greek accents, Vietnamese TELEX, Turkish multi-tap, Danish, Dutch, and Norwegian.

Fixes include keyboard bottom clipping, Android <14 subtype crashes, speech-recognition language selection, F-Droid update-check behavior, symbol-only substitutions, Ctrl passthrough, modifier latch/hold handling, apostrophe/elision autocorrect, Q25 Alt mappings, subtype/layout resolution, Backspace behavior with selected text, IME visibility loops, Pastierina suggestion visibility, and emoji search focus routing.

Several Nightly-only regressions and CI/signing/F-Droid release paths were also cleaned up during the 0.85 Nightly phase. Those are included as stabilization work, not as headline Stable-user features.
